author: PackRat 🐀
name: Snake
description: A touch-first Snake game built specifically for the wide CORSAIR XENEON Edge. Swipe the board or use large directional controls, chase a local high score, and watch the pace climb as the run gets longer. Every official XENEON slot size uses its own board geometry so the game stays readable instead of simply shrinking. No account, no network data, no helper app, and no maintenance dependency.
